name: Text button
for: A quiet action written as link-coloured words beside other text (Undo, Review…, Reset to defaults, Choose image…).
notFor: A main or secondary action (use the Button), a link that goes somewhere (an `<a>`), or a row in a menu (the menus draw their own rows until the Menu item part).
use: `textButton(words, action, { size, underlined, className })` from `src/ui/text-button/text-button.ts`; `link(text, href, "text-button")` from `src/ui/dom.ts` for an `<a>` with the same look.
variants: compact (`text-button--compact`) has smaller words in a padded box that fills on hover or press, for a panel row; the base size underlines instead; underlined (`text-button--underlined`, `underlined: true`) stays underlined at rest, for words among plain text that must read as a link; disabled fades, as every bare button does
